profile_text.body:
monday.com is a publicly traded software company (Nasdaq: MNDY, CIK 0001845338) that describes itself as an AI work platform designed for both people and AI agents. Its site positions the platform as a single environment where human workers and automated agents execute, manage, and operate together to drive business results.

The company's primary AI product, tracked here as Monday.com AI, is a work operating system that incorporates AI agents intended to run alongside human teams. The site emphasizes that these agents are given relevant context before acting, and that the underlying infrastructure includes enterprise-grade data privacy, governance, permissions, and compliance controls. The product is noted to involve Israeli data transfer considerations, reflecting the company's origins and data residency questions that enterprise customers may face.

No litigation or MCP server entries are held for the company at this time. monday.com offers its platform across segments including small and medium businesses, enterprise customers, and nonprofits, and maintains a marketplace for third-party applications alongside around-the-clock support.
